from unicorn.x86_const import *
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1];b=(R/'prior/inputs/nite3w - 110.exe').read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()=='12fe5168783446275802e0e947898261b5eca6b88288f3a895fc1faa4c544481'
ne=struct.unpack_from('<I',b,0x3c)[0];st=ne+struct.unpack_from('<H',b,ne+0x22)[0];shift=struct.unpack_from('<H',b,ne+0x32)[0];o,n,_,_=struct.unpack_from('<4H',b,st+16);code=bytearray(b[o<<shift:(o<<shift)+n])
relocations=[]
for r in json.loads((R/'pass2/relocation_chain_sites.json').read_text()):
 if r['source_segment']==3 and 0x9fa2<=r['source']<0xa0c5:
  assert r['type']==2 and r['flags']==0 and r['target_segment']==4
  struct.pack_into('<H',code,r['source'],0x1018);relocations.append(r['source'])

for row in csv.DictReader(listing.open(),delimiter='\t'):
 if row['function']=='1010:9fa2':
  a=int(row['address'].split(':')[1],16);assert code[a:a+len(row['bytes'])//2].hex()==row['bytes'];instruction_byte_checks+=1

def s16(x):return (x+32768)%65536-32768
def model(kind,weapon,difficulty,episode,depth,baseline,rng):
 v=s16(s16(depth-baseline)*8+rng%25);notify=kind==0x15
 if kind in [0xc,0x1d]:shift=3
 elif kind==0xd:shift=1 if weapon==1 else 3
 elif kind in [0xe,0x11,0x14]:shift=1 if weapon==2 else 3
 elif kind in [0xf,0x10]:shift=8 if weapon==1 else 1
 elif kind in [0x12,0x13]:shift=2
 elif kind in [0x15,0x19]:v=0;shift=0
 elif kind==0x16:v=3 if episode==3 else 0;shift=0
 elif kind==0x17:shift=8 if weapon==1 else 2
 elif kind==0x18:shift=8 if weapon==1 else 4 if weapon==2 else 3
 elif kind==0x1a:
  if weapon!=1:v=0
  shift=1 if weapon==1 else 0
 elif kind in [0x1b,0x1c]:shift=1
 elif kind==0x1e:
  if weapon==1:v=0
  shift=3 if weapon!=1 else 0
 elif kind==0x1f:
  if weapon==1:v=0
  shift=2 if weapon!=1 else 0
 else:shift=0
 v>>=shift
 if difficulty==2:v>>=1
 elif difficulty==0:v=s16(v*2)
 if v>255:v=255
 return v&65535,int(notify)
uc=Uc(UC_ARCH_X86,UC_MODE_16);uc.mem_map(0,0x100000)
CS=0x1010;DS=0x1048;SS=0x9000;ENTRY=(CS<<4)+0x9fa2;STOP=0x40000;RNG=(0x1018<<4)+0x32d2;NOTIFY=(0x1018<<4)+0x083e
uc.mem_write((CS<<4)+0x9fa2,bytes(code[0x9fa2:0xa0c5]));uc.mem_write(RNG,b'\xcb');uc.mem_write(NOTIFY,b'\xcb');uc.mem_write(STOP,b'\x90')
ctx={}
def hook(uc,address,size,user):
 if address==RNG:ctx['rng_calls']+=1;uc.reg_write(UC_X86_REG_AX,ctx['rng'])
 elif address==NOTIFY:
  ctx['notify_calls']+=1;sp=uc.reg_read(UC_X86_REG_SP);assert bytes(uc.mem_read((SS<<4)+sp+4,4))==struct.pack('<I',0x12345678)
 elif address==STOP:ctx['stopped']=True;uc.emu_stop()
for at in [RNG,NOTIFY,STOP]:uc.hook_add(UC_HOOK_CODE,hook,begin=at,end=at)
def w(at,value):uc.mem_write((DS<<4)+at,struct.pack('<H',value&65535))
cases=0;negatives=0;examples=[]

 global cases,negatives
 ctx.update(rng=rng,rng_calls=0,notify_calls=0,stopped=False)

 for reg,val in [(UC_X86_REG_CS,CS),(UC_X86_REG_DS,DS),(UC_X86_REG_ES,DS),(UC_X86_REG_SS,SS),(UC_X86_REG_SP,0xf000),(UC_X86_REG_EFLAGS,2)]:uc.reg_write(reg,val)
 uc.mem_write((SS<<4)+0xf000,struct.pack('<6H',0,0x4000,0,0,0x1000,DS))
 uc.mem_write((DS<<4)+0x1006,bytes([kind]));w(0x1018,depth);w(0x53ee,baseline);w(0x4c14,difficulty);w(0x7e52,episode);uc.mem_write((DS<<4)+0x4c23,bytes([weapon]));uc.mem_write((DS<<4)+0x192,struct.pack('<I',0x12345678))
 uc.emu_start(ENTRY,0xfffff,count=1000)
 got=uc.reg_read(UC_X86_REG_AX);expected,notify=model(kind,weapon,difficulty,episode,depth,baseline,rng)
 assert ctx['stopped'] and ctx['rng_calls']==1 and ctx['notify_calls']==notify
 assert uc.reg_read(UC_X86_REG_SP)==0xf004
 assert got==expected,(kind,weapon,difficulty,episode,depth,baseline,rng,got,expected)
 if got&32768:negatives+=1
 cases+=1
 return got
for args in itertools.product(list(range(0xc,0x20))+[0,0x20,255],range(4),[0,1,2],[1,3],[(0,0),(1,0),(0,1),(4095,0),(0x8000,0)],[0,24,25,255,32767]):
 kind,weapon,difficulty,episode,pair,rng=args;run(kind,weapon,difficulty,episode,*pair,rng)

for rng in range(32768):assert rng%25==rng-25*(rng//25)
for depth in [0,1,0xffff,0x8000,4095]:
 result=run(0,0,1,1,depth,1,0);examples.append(dict(depth=depth,baseline=1,AX=result,caller_low_byte=result&255))
out=dict(exe_sha256=hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),engine='Unicorn '+unicorn.__version__,original_instruction_cases=cases,negative_AX_cases=negatives,rng_range_remainder_cases=32768,selector_relocations_applied=relocations,instruction_byte_checks=instruction_byte_checks,relocated_function_sha256=hashlib.sha256(code[0x9fa2:0xa0c5]).hexdigest(),examples=examples,rng_calls_per_case=1,auxiliary_call_stub='1018:083E, DWORD argument checked',runtime_game_execution=False,limits=['RNG returns stubbed0..32767; original PRNG/state not executed','083E side effects stubbed, only call count/argument checked','16-bit real-mode test memory with controlled nonaliasing globals/object/stack; not full Win16 OS','Damage application caller not executed; AL interpretation documented separately'])
